notes: Summary: Ginkgo HelpMontage builds multichannel helpdesk workflows for mid-size ecommerce merchants. Heavy Zendesk + Freshdesk customers. Interested in automating triage, summarization, and smart tagging to reduce AHT and improve routing accuracy.

Primary ask: concise ticket + email summaries for agents (1-2 sentence TL;DR) plus automated tag suggestions and triggers for macros. Should work reliably during Black Friday–like spikes (burst from 200 to 10k msgs/hr).
Quote from Director of Product (Maya R): 'If the model can't keep accuracy under load we lose trust — we need repeatable latency/throughput numbers and fallback behavior.'
Technical constraints: must support VPC deployment for routing customer data, KMS integration for key management, 13-month retention policy, and SSO via SAML with Okta.

Initial benchmark: Redwood hosted API baseline produced 180ms median token latency for short summaries in our lab (good). Concern: unknown behaviour when autoscaling under sustained spike — wants Dedicated run.
- Week 0: mapping workshop (fields → tags, Zendesk triggers, Freshdesk workflows) — mapping doc in Drive
- Week 1: lightweight hosted POC for summary quality + tagging precision on historical ticket batch (10k tickets) — acceptance metric: >=85% tag precision top-3
- Week 2: Dedicated stress run with synthetic spike and macros automation (validate autoscale + fallback to lower-capacity variant)
- Week 3: security review + network checklist completion (customer legal + infra sign-off)
Timeline notes: security team requested SOC2 artefacts and network diagrams 2026-02-20 (drive link). Legal requested DPA amendment; procurement waiting on final SOW pricing.
Meetings / comms: discovery 2026-01-15 (ff_9a8b7c3e), demo 2026-02-05 (ff_demo_02), security deep-dive 2026-02-20 (ff_4d2f11). AE threads in Gmail (thread-CA+ginkgo-intro-01).

POC highlights: tagging edge cases — multi-intent tickets often need 2 tags; customer wants ordered priority tags for triggers. We suggested deterministic tag suggestions + human-in-loop quick-accept macro.
Operational ask: Webhook tool-calls to run macros (close ticket, escalate to specialist queue) — need docs on Redwood's function/tool calling for actionability (SE to provide runbook).

Cost sensitivity: moderate — willing to commit to Dedicated if unit costs under $0.0008/token equivalent for high-throughput routing. Optimize team interest to tune batching and KV caching for ticket prefix reuse.

Risks: 1) legal DPA delay, 2) VPC peering config complexity, 3) tagging precision drop during high-concurrency spikes. Proposed mitigations in POC: canary routing, automatic fallback to smaller model, and pre-warm cache.

Next actions (AE/SE): SE to deliver stress-run plan and draft SOW by 2026-03-12; AE to follow up on DPA signature with legal. Customer to provide sample Zendesk triggers + 10k anonymized tickets for initial training/quality eval.
